steps.action: Tick "Comes with a pass (FITPASS, cultpass and others)"
user_sees: Hint: "They pay a pass company, not your gym. No plan and no dues, and never on the renewal list. Each visit counts for the pass company."
"Pass company" chips: FITPASS, cultpass, any other company this gym already uses, and "+ Other company"
No company picked yet
must_not: A company picked by default

steps.action: Tap "FITPASS", fill name and mobile, tap "Add member"
user_sees: The member's page; the member is a pass member from today
must_not: A plan or dues asked for
The member on the renewal list

start: Add member sheet open, "Comes with a pass" ticked

steps.action: Tap "+ Other company"
user_sees: A box "Pass company name" in focus, placeholder "Fitternity"
must_not: A chip left picked as well

steps.action: Type "fit pass", fill name and mobile, tap "Add member"
user_sees: The member is saved under "FITPASS" (the known spelling)
must_not: A second company "fit pass" in the chips next time

start: The page of a member who has no pass

steps.action: Tap "Edit", tick "Comes with a pass (FITPASS, cultpass and others)", tap "cultpass", tap "Save changes"
user_sees: The sheet closes; the member is a pass member from today
must_not: Money already paid by the member removed
The pass start set to the joining date

start: Add member sheet open, name and mobile filled, "Comes with a pass" ticked, no company picked

steps.action: Tap "Add member"
user_sees: Under the Pass company chips: "Pick or type the pass company."
The sheet stays open
must_not: A pass member saved with no company
The member saved as a normal member without a word
Nothing visible happening (the message off the screen)

steps.action: Tap "+ Other company" and type 45 letters
user_sees: The box stops at 40 letters
must_not: A longer name saved

start: The page of a FITPASS member who has been a pass member since last month

steps.action: Tap "Edit"
user_sees: The tick is on and "FITPASS" is picked
must_not: The tick off for a pass member

steps.action: Change only the name and tap "Save changes"
user_sees: Still a pass member since the same day as before
must_not: The pass start moved to today

steps.action: Tap "Edit", untick "Comes with a pass", tap "Save changes"
user_sees: The member is a normal member with no pass company
must_not: Past pass visits removed from the pass count

steps.action: Tap "Edit", tick it again, tap "FITPASS", tap "Save changes"
user_sees: A pass member again, from today
must_not: The old start day back as if the break never happened without anyone choosing that
